rows.en: Celica: "What's that mech? I've never seen that model before..."
Ai: "Anyway, if they're under attack, we've got to help!"
Celica: "You're right. All right! Spirit Mechs, launch!"
Garyud: "..."
Ciel: "...Ghh..."
Reduce: "Calm down. Getting impatient
won't solve anything."
Ciel: "Reduce?! Doesn't it frustrate you?!"
Reduce: "..."
Ciel: "I hate this! Just sitting here watching!
How can you stay so calm...?"
Reduce: "...Do you think I'm all right with it? They call me one of the Three Sword Knights,
yet without an Armored Mech, I can't do anything...
They saved my life, and I can't even repay them..."
Ciel: "...Oh. I-I'm sorry..."
Garyud: "...Reduce. Look after Ciel."
Ciel: "Huh...? Father?"
Reduce: "...Where are you going?"
Garyud: "Something's been on my mind.
Well, I hope it's just my imagination."
Reduce: "..."
Garyud: "..."
Reduce: "Understood. Take care."
Garyud: "I'm putting you to some trouble."
Reduce: "Not at all. I'm used to it."
Garyud: "Heh... Well said... Then I'm counting on you!"
Ciel: "Oh... F-Father...
...H-Hey, what does this mean? What's Father...?"
Reduce: "Lord Garyud has his own
plans. We need only trust him and follow them.
Or can't you trust your own father?"
Ciel: "...You're quite mean, you know.
But... You're right. Let's trust Father.
And them."
Reduce: "...Yes."
Clovis: "Hey. Looks like you're having a hard time."
Aurelie: "Hmph! These guys are nothing.
Just don't get in my way."
Clovis: "Oh, how cold... And here I pushed myself
to come all this way for you, my love..."
Aurelie: "...Huh? R-Really...?"
Clovis: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Huh... Um, well..."
Clovis: "...Just kidding.
Well? I pulled that off pretty well, didn't I?"
Aurelie: "...Y-You..."
Clovis: "Hmm? What's wrong?"
Aurelie: "..."
Clovis: "H-Hey! Are you trying to kill me?!"
Aurelie: "Hmph!"
Xiujian: "...He hasn't changed."
Arthur: "Well, I doubt this man ever will.
...It's been a while, Xiujian."
Xiujian: "Yes. You seem well too."
Touya: "Is this really the time for a leisurely reunion?!"
Aurelie: "...So that's him? The promising newcomer?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Aurelie: "I hear you piloted Zeifon
on your very first battle. I'm counting on you."
Xiujian: "...First, let's see what you can do."
Touya: "Doesn't seem like much of a welcome..."
Arthur: "Unlike a certain someone, they're serious.
They want to see your skill with their own eyes."
Clovis: "Would that certain someone be a cheerful
ladies' man and all-around nice guy?"
Arthur: "Don't you mean 'a womanizer whose only redeeming feature is being cheerful'
instead?"
Clovis: "A man's finished once he loses interest in women, you know?
Anyway, show them what you've got.
Right, Touya?"
Touya: "R-Right!"
Yamato: "Touya! I'm sure you know this already,
but even in a fight that looks unwinnable, 'Trust Commands'
can sometimes help you find a way through!
Don't give up to the end! Let's show everyone
what you can do as a leader!"
Touya: "You bet!"
Miyasco: "Oh!
The hatch has been forced open from inside!"
Celica: "What?! Who on earth
would do something that stupid...?"
Fain: "All right, here I go! Hah!"
Derock: "...H-He jumped down.
But somehow, I feel like he'll probably be all right."
Fain: "...L-Landing... s-successful..."
Celica: "That idiot..."
Fain: "Dah hah hah hah! I'm here to help, everyone!
Heh heh heh... If you don't fear Fain Jin Barion,
come at me from any direction!!"
Ymir: "..."
Celica: "...Sigh."
Ai: "H-Hey, wait! I'm not letting you get away!"
Touya: "Ai, pursuing too far is dangerous!"
Arthur: "Touya is right.
Besides, your mech was only just destroyed, wasn't it?
Let's repair it before the enemy returns."
Arthur: "Touya is right.
This won't be as easy as it was with our previous enemies."
Ai: "Tch. All right!"
Fain: "Uoooooh! Move! Move! Move! Moooove!!"
Celica: "He... Surely he isn't..."
Fain: "Hm! The Prana isn't flowing well...
I still lack spirit... Right, next I'll go all out..."
Celica: "Idiot, idiot, idiot! Fain, you idiot!"
Fain: "Huh...?"
Celica: "Don't give me 'huh'!
First you climb into Dusseldorf without permission,
then you start piloting it recklessly...
I'm telling Rest!"
Fain: "N-No, that's..."
Celica: "Do you understand?!"
Fain: "Y-Yes... I understand..."
Celica: "Good. Anyway, help Touya and the others for now.
You can handle the piloting, right?"
Fain: "Yes... Huh? Then that means..."
Celica: "We're short of pilots, and there's nobody to use Dusseldorf
right now. We need all the fighting strength we can get.
If you genuinely want to pilot it,
I'll ask my brother for you."
Fain: "R-Really?! Yahoo!!"
Celica: "Then I'll make a special exception this time.
...Now, as for its weapons..."
Fain: "I understand! With this Vial Jade and
Voltic Lancer, I shall drive the enemy before me!"
Celica: "No, you don't! Both of those can make area attacks,
but their range isn't that long,
so just using them blindly won't do you any good.
Also, Vial Jade can't be used
after moving. Keep that in mind. And another thing...
Both weapons are especially effective when enemies are next to each other...
Are you listening?!"
Fain: "Yes! There is no problem!
As expected of a Spirit Mech you raised with such care, Princess!"
Celica: "...Sigh. Well, fine.
Just don't do anything reckless, okay?!
I'll never forgive you if you break Dusseldorf!"
Fain: "Leave it to me! Victory in this battle, for the princess!!"
Celica: "...Honestly... Does he really understand...?"
Celica: "Faaaaaiiiiin..."
Fain: "H-Ha ha ha ha ha..."
Celica: "This isn't funny!
Do you know what you've done?!"
Fain: "...I'm sorry..."
Celica: "Honestly! We've only just finished it,
and what would you do if Dusseldorf broke?!"
Fain: "But..."
Celica: "No buts! If you do anything like this again,
I'll cancel your Pilot registration!"
Fain: "Yes... Huh? Pilot registration?
...Then that means..."
Celica: "There's nobody else who can use Dusseldorf right now anyway,
and we need all the fighting strength we can get. If you genuinely
want to pilot it, I'll ask my brother for you."
Fain: "R-Really?! Yahoo!!"
Touya: "...Will this really be all right?"
Celica: "Fain's Prana is getting stronger by the day.
Unusually so for an Agarthian.
It'll be fine. He'll learn to handle it splendidly."
Touya: "You trust him, huh?"
Celica: "He's just a liiittle too fired up."
Touya: "True."
Lodis: "...I'm glad everyone's safe."
Ymir: "Yes. But Lady Alforina..."
Tix: "So it's really... true?"
Garyud: "...It is.
We rescued her once, but the chancellor, Oswald,
took her life. Her Majesty has passed away."
Tix: "No... Why would a country's chancellor murder its sovereign?!
That makes no sense... It makes no sense!"
Lodis: "...Calm down, Tix.
...Lord Garyud. What about Lord Exogilm?"
Garyud: "He's dead."
Lodis: "I see...
Could Zigrim be behind this?"
Garyud: "I don't know. There is no conclusive proof,
but Prince Cain of Limberg may be involved."
Tix: "Cain! You met Cain?!
Sister?!"
Celica: "Yes... But he'd changed a great deal.
Unlike back then, he was full of confidence..."
Tix: "But it was Cain, wasn't it?"
Celica: "Y-Yes."
Tix: "Then it couldn't have been Cain.
You know he's not the sort of person
who could do something like that, don't you?"
Celica: "That's true, but..."
Lodis: "Tix. You mustn't judge things
by personal feelings. What you can see isn't
always the whole truth."
Tix: "!! You suspect Cain, brother?!"
Lodis: "That's not what I mean. I'm saying we have
too little information to discuss it here.
I want you to learn to look squarely at the truth."
Lodis: "In any case, the situation is still unpredictable.
There's much we don't understand about Zigrim's seemingly hasty invasion,
and we'll need to be careful about our next move..."
Brother... Surely you don't mean to let Zigrim's outrage
go unchallenged? Of course you don't, right?!
We can't allow something like this!
Brother, let's send the army! We're the leading power on the continent!"
Celica: "Tix..."
Lodis: "Tix. I understand how you feel.
But if Agarthia acts now, Limberg will act too.
Fram Zeo Isfandeil
would never miss such an opportunity.
I cannot plunge the continent into war..."
Tix: "B-But they might attack Agarthia
next, you know?!"
Lodis: "I, too, believe Zigrim's outrage is unforgivable.
But that doesn't mean we can
sink to their level.
Besides, she wouldn't have wanted that."
Tix: "How can you know that, brother?!
Queen Alforina must be frustrated too! Why
did she have to die...? Why...? Ghh!"
Celica: "Tix! Wait!"
Lodis: "Celica, it's best to leave him alone for now.
Tix must understand too.
He's just confused."
Celica: "That may be true, but..."
Clovis: "He's right. You're being a little overprotective.
Treating that prince like that
isn't doing him any good, is it?"
Celica: "Y-You think so? ...All right.
I'll leave him be for now."
Ai: "Lodis... The Kingdom of Agarthia knew about Zigrim's invasion,
but didn't warn them... Why?"
Lodis: "I'm sorry. It was my failure to do enough..."
Ai: "Apologizing to me won't help.
That isn't what I'm asking.
I'm asking why you left them to die!"
Ymir: "Ai... Taking it out on His Highness won't help.
Besides..."
Lodis: "No. Ai is right.
I underestimated the situation. Even if I didn't know,
I could have foreseen some of it.
But I did no more than urge caution...
And not knowing that Agarthia's government had decided to stand by
was negligence on my part..."
Ai: "...Tell me how you yourself feel, Lodis.
I want to hear your honest answer."
Lodis: "I'm here not as Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Agarthia,
but as one individual named Lodis.
The kingdom's decision does not bind me."
Ai: "...I see... I'm sorry for being so rude."
Lodis: "No. Considering how you feel...
Besides, I, too... No, let's leave that.
For now, getting ready is our highest priority."
????: "Working yourselves too hard isn't wise, either."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel!"
Ivel: "It's been a long time, Ymir.
I watched your battle.
It seems you've found some fine people to help you."
Garyud: "It's been a long time."
Ivel: "Thirty-four years, was it?"
Garyud: "Yes."
Ivel: "We've both grown old, haven't we?"
Garyud: "No. You haven't changed."
Ivel: "My, you're as charming as ever."
Garyud: "It's no flattery. The radiance of your soul
shines just as it did back then."
Ymir: "...You and Lord Garyud were acquainted, Lady Ivel,
were you?"
Ivel: "Yes. We're old acquaintances, aren't we?"
Garyud: "Yes."
Touya: "...Who's that old lady?"
Celica: "Hey! How could you..."
Ivel: "Now, now. The boy is quite right.
Forgive my late introduction. I serve as the head of this Holy Land.
Allow me to introduce myself:
My name is Ivel Eal Rochforn."
Touya: "Huh? Then that means..."
Celica: "She's the most important person here! Normally,
she isn't someone you can just casually meet like this!"
Touya: "H-Ha ha ha..."
Celica: "Honestly..."
Ivel: "Now, now. There's no harm done.
What good does it do for you to be angrier than the person concerned?"
Celica: "Huh? Oh, I-I'm sorry..."
Ivel: "Besides, I'm not important in my own right.
The authority belongs to the position of 'Matriarch.'
Oh, yes.
The Agarthian Council contacted me earlier
with a proposal concerning you."
Celica: "The Council...?
Brother, do you know anything about this?"
Lodis: "No. Though I can more or less guess..."
Ivel: "...From now on, the activities of the Spirit Mechs would receive
the full backing of Agarthia's government,
and independent operating authority under its approval.
In exchange, you would report all combat data and any information on the ≪Ze=Ode≫.
All of it, without exception.
That is their proposal."
Arthur: "In other words, we'd be carrying the Kingdom of Agarthia's
banner.
And our freedom of action wouldn't be guaranteed.
They're effectively asking us to become an organization of the Kingdom of Agarthia,
aren't they?"
Clovis: "Just the sort of thing the big shots would think up.
Who the hell do they think they are?"
Ivel: "I doubt they expect us to accept
those conditions. Perhaps all they want is the fact
that we rejected their proposal."
Lodis: "That's probably it.
If that's their intention, we should delay our answer
for as long as possible."
Ivel: "Yes. I agree.
We'll deal with that matter."
Lodis: "Yes."
Ivel: "Now, let's leave that subject there.
It's about time I introduced your new crew members.
Please come in."
???: "Excuse me."
Celica: "Oh, Bart! It's been a while!"
Bart: "It's been a long time, Princess Celica.
I'll be serving as your purser.
I'm Bart Jin Gakkyok.
If there's anything you need, just say the word.
I'll procure whatever it is."
Celica: "If you're here, Bart, does that mean she's here too?"
Bart: "Yes. She only just arrived.
Of course, His Highness Lodis hasn't been told yet..."
Lodis: "S-Surely not..."
???: "Your Hiiighness♥"
Lodis: "!! S-Sisk...
Lady Ivel! What's the meaning of this?!
Nobody told me!"
Sisk: "Hee hee. I wanted to surprise you, Your Highness,
so I asked them to keep it a secret.
Were you surprised?"
Lodis: "Surprised hardly begins to... You're not a warrior,
are you? Why...?"
Sisk: "You don't have to be a warrior to become an observer.
Didn't you know?"
Lodis: "B-But..."
Sisk: "Won't you be coming aboard Liebhofen, Your Highness?"
Lodis: "N-No. It would look rather bad to the outside world
if I came along... More importantly, who hired Sisk...?"
Ymir: "I did. Was there a problem?"
Lodis: "A problem? Well..."
Ymir: "Sisk did very well on her aptitude test.
And she has a cook's license,
so we also hired her as a cook.
Any issue between you and her is a personal matter."
Lodis: "N-No, well, yes, that's true...
This is awkward... It can't be helped. Sisk, I'm counting on you to do your job well."
Sisk: "I know. For you, Your Highness, Sisk will
do her very best♥"
Touya: "Hey, Celica. Sisk and His Highness Lodis...
What's their relationship?"
Celica: "She's my brother's devoted fan."
Touya: "A fan...? What is he, a celebrity...?"
Celica: "She's actually a lady-in-waiting at the palace, but...
I never thought she'd go this far. My brother has his work cut out for him.
...Well, half of it's his own fault."
Touya: "His own fault?"
Celica: "Yes. It was my brother who made the first move..."
Lodis: "Celica! What are you whispering about over there?!"
Celica: "Oh, no, nothing! ...Touya,
we'd better not talk about this now. Anyway, that's how it is."
Ciel: "I never imagined His Highness Lodis would..."
Touya: "...Even a crown prince is only human, huh?"
Ivel: "And finally... Your new captain of Liebhofen,
Admiral Roa Jin Krankheit.
He originally commanded forces in York's military,
and has specially agreed to take this post."
Reduce: "A-Admiral!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Garyud: "So you've finally decided to get moving.
With you in command, Admiral, we can rest easy."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ai: '...Is he famous?'
Ciel: 'Huh?! Oh, right.
In the great war 33 years ago, he used seven ships
to run rings around five Zigrim squadrons. A brilliant commander.
Though he's better known as an eccentric
who only ever says "hmm."'
Ai: 'Huh...'
Captain Roa: "..."
Ai: "Oh, he's coming over."
Ciel: "Y-Yes?"
Captain Roa: "..."
Ai: "Looks like he wants to shake hands."
Ciel: "Oh, forgive me.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Ciel Ren Vratzen."
Captain Roa: "...Hmm."
Ciel: "..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "That old guy's holding her hand and not moving a muscle."
Garyud: "A-Admiral. That's quite enough.
You're making Ciel uncomfortable."
Captain Roa: "...H-Hmm."
Touya: "...Hey, is he in a bad mood or something?
He hasn't said a word this whole time."
Ymir: "Really?
He said he was pleased to meet you."
Touya: "Huh? All I heard was 'hmm'..."
Ymir: "Oh, you're joking..."
???: "Ymir, my dear big sister♥"
Ymir: "Wah! E-Emy?!"
Emy: "I missed you!
How could you be so cruel and leave me behind?!"
Fain: "Y-Ymir...
I-I didn't realize your tastes ran that way..."
Ymir: "H-Hey..."
Emy: "That's right. My dear sister and I
share a veeeery deep bond! Don't we, my dear sister♥"
Fain: "Ooooooh! How could this beee?!"
Touya: "Th-There's that sound again."
Ai: "Again...? The crystal's ringing?"
Touya: "Yeah. You really can't hear it?"
Ai: "No, not at all. Let me see it."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Ai: "...Wh-What's that?"
Ivel: "That's... the Resonance Crystal."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel..."
Ivel: "...Surely not..."
Ai: "Huh?! What? What's happening?"
Ymir: "Th-That's..."
Emy: "No way... Rayode?!"
